zh: 设置页收了一次形：检查更新不再是自成一张的深色小卡，而是并入页尾的「关于」区——产品名下直接是版本号与检查更新一行，关于卡因此少了一次视觉断点。同步区删掉了常驻的登录表单（服务器地址、邮箱、密码三行输入），没登录时给一枚「登录」按钮，点开就是首次使用的引导页；登录后仍是账号面板与退出登录。顺手清掉快捷键图例和登录表单背后的死代码，设置视图模型瘦身约八十行。
en: The settings page got reshaped. Check-for-updates is no longer its own dark card: it now lives inside the About section at the foot of the page — under the product name you get the version chip and the update row, so the About card lost a visual break it never needed. The sync section dropped its resident sign-in form (server, email, password); when signed out there is a single sign-in button that opens the same onboarding page used on first run, and when signed in you still get the account panel and sign-out. The keyboard-shortcut legend went too, along with the form's dead code — about eighty lines off the settings view model.
